# satisfactory_extractor (Resource)

A miner, water extractor or other resource extractor, placed on a world feature (resource node, geyser or water volume) rather than at a coordinate. Find the feature with the `satisfactory_resource_nodes` data source. One extractor per node; the node stays occupied until this is destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find a node first; extractors are placed on a world feature, not at a point.
data "satisfactory_resource_nodes" "iron" {
  resource = "Desc_OreIron_C"
  purity   = "normal"
  x        = -77737
  y        = 220338
  z        = -337
}

resource "satisfactory_extractor" "iron" {
  class   = "Build_MinerMk2_C"
  node_id = data.satisfactory_resource_nodes.iron.nodes[0].id
  # clock_speed defaults to 1.0 on create and updates in place.
  clock_speed = 1.0
}

# Water volumes are areas: say where on the surface the extractor goes.
data "satisfactory_resource_nodes" "water" {
  resource = "Desc_Water_C"
  x        = -77737
  y        = 220338
  z        = -337
}

resource "satisfactory_extractor" "water" {
  class   = "Build_WaterPump_C"
  node_id = data.satisfactory_resource_nodes.water.nodes[0].id
  x       = data.satisfactory_resource_nodes.water.nodes[0].x + 1000
  y       = data.satisfactory_resource_nodes.water.nodes[0].y
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) Extractor class name, e.g. Build_MinerMk1_C, Build_MinerMk2_C or Build_WaterPump_C.
- `node_id` (String) Id of the feature to bind to, from `satisfactory_resource_nodes.nodes[*].id`.

### Optional

- `clock_speed` (Number) Clock speed as a fraction (1.0 = 100%). Changeable in place. Defaults to 1.0 on create.
- `x` (Number) World X in centimetres. Settable only for water volumes, which are areas: pick a point on the surface within the volume's bounds. For a node the game decides and this reports where it landed.
- `y` (Number) World Y in centimetres. See x.
- `yaw` (Number) Rotation in degrees. Omitted, the feature's own placement rotation is used and reported here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform-assigned stable ID, persisted in the save game by the mod.
- `z` (Number) World Z in centimetres, as placed by the game.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the resource's tf_id (the UUID the mod persists in the save).
terraform import satisfactory_extractor.iron "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789"
```
